title: NHK Special — 日本の半導体産業の復活 (Japan's Semiconductor Industry Revival)
description: From NHK Special. Full-speed native documentary examining Japan's attempt to rebuild its domestic semiconductor industry amid global supply chain tensions. Covers government policy, private investment, the TSMC Kumamoto factory, and debate over economic security vs. free trade. Dense vocabulary: 半導体、供給網、経済安全保障、国産化、補助金. Authentic N1-level listening with fast narration and expert interviews.
creator: NHK (日本放送協会)
